mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_NOTIFICATION (NOTIFICATION_ID, RECEIVER_TYPE, MEMBER_ID, NTF_TYPE, NTF_DETAIL, NTF_TITLE, NTF_CONTENT, LINK_URL, IS_IMPORTANT, IS_READ, NTF_CHANNEL, CREATED_AT, SENT_AT) VALUES (SEQ_NOTIFICATION.NEXTVAL, #{receiverType}, #{memberId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{ntfType}, #{ntfDetail}, #{ntfTitle}, #{ntfContent}, #{linkUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isImportant}, 'N', #{ntfChannel}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION WHERE RECEIVER_TYPE = '02' AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE RECEIVER_TYPE = '02' AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION WHERE RECEIVER_TYPE = '01' AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID = #{id} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
UPDATE TBL_NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE RECEIVER_TYPE = '01' AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT n.*, m.MEMBER_NAME FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION n LEFT JOIN TBL_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = n.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY n.CREATED_AT DESC, n.NOTIFICATION_ID DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION_SETTING ORDER BY SETTING_ID) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_NOTIFICATION_SETTING (SETTING_ID, IS_ACTIVE, QUIET_ENABLED, QUIET_START, QUIET_END, SMS_FALLBACK, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_NOTIFICATION_SETTING.NEXTVAL, 'Y', 'Y', '22:00', '08:00', 'Y', SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_NOTIFICATION_SETTING SET IS_ACTIVE = #{isActive}, QUIET_ENABLED = #{quietEnabled}, QUIET_START = #{quietStart}, QUIET_END = #{quietEnd}, SMS_FALLBACK = #{smsFallback}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE SETTING_ID = #{settingId}
